title: Tenant-aware observability orchestration and automated rollback playbook
author: Maya Chen
description: Introduce a tenant-aware orchestration layer for observability provisioning and a deterministic rollback playbook for Private installs. Motivation: private installations require per-tenant isolation of dashboards, alert routing, and log shippers but current provisioning is manual and brittle during upgrades. This PR adds a Terraform module that wires tenant metadata into alert routing and tenant-scoped Grafana folder provisioning, a Helm chart (observability-operator) that deploys per-tenant Grafana dashboards and Prometheus scrape config overlays, an idempotent shell installer to provision observability artifacts, and a documented rollback playbook that can be executed by SREs or automation when an observability upgrade causes regressions. Key goals: tenant isolation, safe staged promotion of alert rules, deterministic downgrade path, and minimal blast radius during upgrades.

small_snippets:
# terraform tenant_alert_router example
module "tenant_alert_router" {
  source = "./modules/tenant_alert_router"
  tenant_id = var.tenant_id
}
# helm template fragment for Grafana folder assignment
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: grafana-folder-{{ .Values.tenant.id }}
data:
  folder.json: |
    {"title": "Tenant-{{ .Values.tenant.id }}"}
# rollout safety marker used by provision script
PROVISION_MARKER=v1.3.0-obs-operator
if kubectl get cm observability-rollout-${PROVISION_MARKER} --namespace observability; then
  echo "already provisioned"
fi

release_notes: Add tenant-scoped observability orchestration: Terraform module for tenant alert routing, Helm-based observability-operator to provision per-tenant Grafana folders and Prometheus overlays, idempotent provisioning script, and an SRE rollback playbook for safe downgrades. Includes unit tests and CI validation.
risk_summary: Medium: changes the provisioning path for tenant observability artifacts. Mitigations include dry-run mode, terratest coverage, and an executable rollback playbook. Default behavior is backward compatible for existing tenants.

changelog_entry: v1.3.0 - Observability: tenant orchestration + rollback playbook; terraform module + helm operator; idempotent provisioning
manual_tests_performed: deployed to staging cluster with 3 tenants, validated folder isolation, simulated alert promotion with feature flag, executed rollback playbook and verified state restored
observability_migration_plan: staged promotion: dry-run -> single-tenant canary -> 10% tenants -> 100% tenants. Each stage requires success criteria: alert latency under threshold, no unexpected alert firing, dashboard rendering OK. Promotion uses the provision script with --promote-stage flag.
